title: Fix Natural Aim PvP Gating
objective: Keep Natural Aim Assist active and useful during real PvP movement/clicking while preserving deliberate mining/use pauses outside combat.
acceptance_criteria: Incidental block-breaking caused by PvP clicks does not pause assistance when a valid combat target is available.
Deliberate mining still pauses assistance when no valid combat target is in the assist envelope.
Target resolution occurs before mining-pause gating so combat context can be considered.
PvP target commitment is not unnecessarily cleared by transient action states.
Regression simulations and Minecraft 26.2 Java 25 build/smoke launch pass.
